memory_candidates.content: When a PATH-shadowed stub script needs to persist state between invocations (a call counter, a recorded argument) but another PATH-shadowed stub needs to read the same state, do not have each stub self-locate its own directory via `dirname "$0"` -- `$0` resolves to the bare command name, not a full path, when the executable is found via a PATH search. Instead have the invoking harness export an explicit directory env var (e.g. STUB_DIR) alongside the PATH prepend, and have every stub read that var (falling back to dirname "$0" only as a last resort).

A test suite whose common_test_resolve_subject call defaults to deploy-tree-first mode will silently exercise the STALE deployed copy of a script under test when verifying a source-store-only change made before the task's own redeploy phase. Override with CORE_TEST_SUBJECT_MODE=source-store for mid-task verification against the real edit, then let the final redeploy phase's own scoped check confirm parity against the deployed copy.

When mechanically checking off a plan phase's checklist items by locating the phase's section boundary, never bound the section with a bare '---' substring search -- a phase's own body text can legitimately contain a literal '---' (e.g. inside a quoted shell comment block like `# --- Constants ---`), which truncates the section early and corrupts unrelated text. Anchor on the next '\n---\n' horizontal-rule line (or the next '### Phase' heading) instead.
